# Claims

<!-- generated by `council verify --write docs/CLAIMS.md`; do not edit -->

Every claim this project makes, and the command that would falsify it.
`council verify` runs them all, and this page is generated from the same
registry, so it cannot describe a claim that has no check.

| id | claim | check |
|---|---|---|
| `verdict-fails-on-proven-blocking` | A proven high finding fails the run. | `python3 -m pytest tests/test_verdict.py::test_a_proven_high_fails -q` |
| `verdict-medium-does-not-block` | A proven medium finding does not fail the run. | `python3 -m pytest tests/test_verdict.py::test_a_proven_medium_passes -q` |
| `verdict-incomplete-is-not-fail` | An unsettled high finding makes the run incomplete, not failed. | `python3 -m pytest tests/test_verdict.py::test_an_unsettled_high_is_incomplete -q` |
| `registry-rejects-uncheckable` | The registry refuses a claim with no check. | `python3 -m pytest tests/test_claims.py::test_a_claim_without_a_check_is_rejected -q` |
| `base-uses-the-merge-base` | With origin/HEAD, the base is the merge-base, not the tip. | `python3 -m pytest tests/test_base.py::test_origin_head_wins_and_uses_the_merge_base -q` |
| `base-falls-back-to-head-parent` | Without origin/HEAD, the base is HEAD~1. | `python3 -m pytest tests/test_base.py::test_without_an_origin_it_falls_back_to_head_tilde_one -q` |
| `base-refuses-when-there-is-none` | A one-commit repository with no origin refuses instead of guessing. | `python3 -m pytest tests/test_base.py::test_one_commit_and_no_origin_refuses -q` |

| `a-bad-sample-is-retried-once` | A sample that does not parse is retried once, then reported as a failure. | `python3 -m pytest tests/test_sample.py::test_a_sample_that_never_parses_reports_why -q` |
